title: Pulse Tap
description: A ring breathes towards a target band. Tap on the beat, build a combo, and keep the streak alive before the tempo runs out.

license.attributionText: Pulse Tap by the Moydan examples contributors, MIT licensed.

assets.source: original artwork drawn for this example
assets.attribution: "Pulse Tap" concentric-ring mark, drawn from scratch for the Moydan examples, MIT licensed.

parameters.label: Starting tempo
parameters.description: Milliseconds per breath at the start of a run. Lower is calmer.

parameters.label: Target band
parameters.description: How wide the target ring is. Wider is more forgiving.

parameters.label: Lives
parameters.description: Misses you can take before the run ends.

parameters.label: Accent colour
parameters.description: Colour of the target band and the pulse ring.

parameters.label: Perfect bonus
parameters.description: Extra points for hitting dead centre of the band.

parameters.label: Sound
parameters.description: Play the Web Audio blips. The host can always mute the game.
